# ARTnews

> > Leading source for art world news covering gallery representation, art market trends, museum exhibitions, artist movements, and major cultural institutions worldwide.

ARTnews provides comprehensive coverage of the international art world, featuring breaking news from major cities including New York, London, Los Angeles, and Venice. The publication reports on gallery sales, artist announcements, museum developments, and art market analysis with contributions from expert journalists including Brian Boucher, Alex Greenberger, and Tessa Solomon.

## Key Topics

- Art Market
- Gallery Representation
- Artist Movements & Announcements
- David Zwirner
- Venice Biennale
- Contemporary Painting
- Gallery Sales
- Museum Exhibitions
- Christie's
- Artist Immigration & O-1B Visas
- New York Art Scene
- London Galleries
- Los Angeles Art Week
- Art Fair Coverage
- Cultural Institution News
